title: Canotto recipe
description: A saved recipe: the dough and the protocol it is baked to, under a name. This is what the app writes when you download a single recipe.

id.description: Stable within one baker's data. Not globally unique.

origin.description: The house protocol ships with the app. Everything else is user made.

derivedFrom.description: The recipe this was duplicated from, if any.

plan.description: What the app suggested when the recipe was generated from a flour. Absent for hand-built recipes, and never authoritative: the dough and protocol above are.

totalHours.description: Total maturation the recipe was built around.

window.description: Published maturation window for the blend, in hours.

idyPct.description: Suggested inoculation as instant dry yeast.

sourced.description: True when every flour in the blend has a published W, false when any was estimated from protein.
